_about: The Frame Departure Register (Core L-491 (b)): each step outside the premise found in a peer account, in the documents or in a Navigator's own output, with the demands it placed counted, its jurisdiction, FOUNDATIONAL FIDELITY (the premise weakened, externalized or qualified) or COMPARATIVE JURISDICTION (a study's requirement applied beyond its object), who found it and where it was corrected. It describes the record and grades no model (M283); a self-reported count is entered as reported. Checked by python3 tools/encroachment.py --docs, line (9).
